items.briefing:
A new MinterEllison report reveals that 71% of Australian organisations experienced a cyber incident in the past year, with AI making attacks faster and more sophisticated. Separately, ecommerce fraud pressure has risen 33%, again driven by AI-powered attacks — a concern for any RTO that sells courses or takes payments online.

Be cautious about unexpected emails or messages asking you to verify your identity or payment details. If something feels off, don't click links — contact the sender directly through a known, trusted phone number or website.

featured.title: Cyber incidents hit 71% of Australian organisations as AI reshapes the threat landscape, MinterEllison report
featured.quote: 71% of Australian organisations hit by cyber incidents as AI transforms threat landscape
